source.english_context: Unit 06 Shopping, Returns, and Services Goal: buy what you need, ask for help, and return items politely. Daily Life English Where can I find laundry detergent? Do you have this in a smaller size? I would like to return this item. Do I need the receipt? How much does this cost? Is this item on sale? Where are the fitting rooms? Do you have this in another color? Is this price before or after tax? Can you check whether another store has it? What is your return policy? Can I exchange this for a different size? The price on the shelf was lower. Could you give me a gift receipt? What time do you close today? Vocabulary aisle a path between store shelves size how big or small something is refund money returned to you exchange return one item and get another sales tax extra tax added at the register customer service the place or people who help shoppers price tag a label showing how much an item costs fitting room a small room where you try on clothes checkout the place where you pay for your purchases return policy a store's rules for taking items back in stock available for sale now gift receipt a receipt that usually hides the price and can help with returns US Customs The price tag may not include sales tax. The final price can be higher. Return rules are different at each store. Keep the receipt and package. It is normal to ask staff, "Excuse me, where is...?" If you cannot find an item, describe what it is used for or show staff a picture of the product. At checkout, wait until the previous customer has finished paying. Some stores use one line for several registers. If a shelf price and register price differ, politely ask staff to check the label before you finish paying. For a return, start by saying what you bought, when you bought it, and whether you want an exchange or refund. Dialogue Student: Excuse me, where is the shampoo? Staff: It is in aisle 8. Student: Thank you. Also, can I return this towel? Staff: Do you have the receipt? Student: Yes, here it is. Staff: Would you like an exchange or a refund? Student: A refund, please. It is the wrong size. Staff: Did you pay with this card? Student: Yes. Do you need me to insert it again? Staff: Yes, please. Then I will give you the refund receipt.

japanese_explanation.heading: 買い物では質問してよい
points: 店員に場所を聞くことは自然です。Excuse me で始めると丁寧に聞こえます。
表示価格に消費税が含まれていないことが多いので、レジで少し高くなることがあります。
返品にはレシート、未使用の状態、期限が必要なことがあります。店ごとにルールが違います。
japanese_explanation.practice: Where can I find laundry detergent?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 买东西时可以开口问
points: 向店员问东西在哪里很自然。用 Excuse me 开头会更礼貌。
标价通常不包括销售税，所以结账时总价可能会高一点。
退货可能需要收据、未使用状态和期限。每家店规则不同。

ko.heading: 쇼핑 시 질문해도 좋습니다
points: 직원에게 위치를 묻는 것은 자연스러운 일입니다. "Excuse me"로 시작하면 정중하게 들립니다.
표시된 가격에 판매세가 포함되지 않은 경우가 많으므로, 계산대에서 최종 가격이 약간 더 높아질 수 있습니다.
반품 시 영수증, 미사용 상태, 기한이 필요할 수 있습니다. 매장마다 규정이 다릅니다.

es.heading: Está bien hacer preguntas al comprar
points: Es natural preguntar a los empleados dónde encontrar algo. Empezar con "Excuse me" suena educado.
El precio indicado a menudo no incluye el impuesto sobre las ventas, por lo que el precio final en la caja puede ser un poco más alto.
Las devoluciones pueden requerir el recibo, que el artículo esté sin usar y un plazo. Las reglas varían en cada tienda.

pt-BR.heading: É permitido fazer perguntas ao fazer compras
points: É natural perguntar a um funcionário onde encontrar algo. Começar com "Excuse me" soa educado.
Frequentemente, o preço exibido não inclui imposto sobre vendas, então o valor final no caixa pode ser um pouco maior.
Devoluções podem exigir o recibo, que o item esteja sem uso e dentro do prazo. As regras variam de loja para loja.

fr.heading: Vous pouvez poser des questions lorsque vous faites des achats
points: Il est naturel de demander aux employés où se trouve un article. Commencer par « Excuse me » (« Excusez-moi ») est une manière polie de s'adresser à eux.
Le prix affiché n'inclut souvent pas la taxe de vente, le prix final à la caisse peut donc être légèrement plus élevé.
Les retours peuvent nécessiter un reçu, que l'article soit inutilisé et qu'il soit effectué dans un certain délai. Les règles varient d'un magasin à l'autre.

de.heading: Sie können beim Einkaufen Fragen stellen
points: Es ist selbstverständlich, Mitarbeiter nach dem Standort von Artikeln zu fragen. Mit „Excuse me“ anzufangen klingt höflich.
Der angezeigte Preis enthält oft keine Mehrwertsteuer, daher kann der Endpreis an der Kasse etwas höher sein.
Rücksendungen können einen Kassenbon, einen unbenutzten Zustand und eine Frist erfordern. Die Regeln sind von Geschäft zu Geschäft unterschiedlich.
